<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Sharlene's Wardrobe">
<title>Sharlene's Wardrobe</title>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { background: #FAF8F4; font-family: Georgia, serif; min-height: 100vh; max-width: 430px; margin: 0 auto; }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes fadein { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
  .fade { animation: fadein 0.4s ease; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="app">

  <!-- HEADER -->
  <div id="header" style="background:#0F0F0F;color:#FAF8F4;padding:52px 20px 20px;">
    <p id="dateLabel" style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;opacity:0.4;font-family:sans-serif;margin:0 0 4px;text-transform:uppercase;"></p>
    <h1 id="greeting" style="font-size:26px;font-weight:400;margin:0 0 4px;">Good morning, Sharlene! 👋</h1>
    <p id="weatherFeel" style="margin:0 0 16px;font-size:14px;opacity:0.7;font-family:sans-serif;line-height:1.5;">Checking the weather... ✨</p>
    <div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);border-radius:14px;padding:13px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;">
      <span id="weatherIcon" style="font-size:26px;">🌡️</span>
      <div style="flex:1;">
        <p id="weatherTemp" style="margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:500;">—</p>
        <p id="weatherDetail" style="margin:2px 0 0;font-size:11px;opacity:0.5;font-family:sans-serif;">Loading weather...</p>
      </div>
      <button onclick="loadOutfit()" id="refreshBtn" style="background:rgba(200,168,130,0.2);border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;color:#C8A882;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:1px;display:none;">↻ NEW LOOK</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TABS -->
  <div style="display:flex;background:#FAF8F4;border-bottom:1px solid #E8E0D0;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;">
    <button onclick="showTab('outfit')" id="tab-outfit" style="flex:1;padding:14px 8px;border:none;background:transparent;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700;color:#1A1A1A;border-bottom:2px solid #1A1A1A;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;">Today's Look</button>
    <button onclick="showTab('wardrobe')" id="tab-wardrobe" style="flex:1;padding:14px 8px;border:none;background:transparent;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:400;color:#BBB;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;">My Wardrobe</button>
  </div>

  <!-- OUTFIT VIEW -->
  <div id="view-outfit">
    <div id="spinner" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:60px 24px;gap:16px;">
      <div style="width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #EDE8E0;border-top-color:#C8A882;animation:spin 0.9s linear infinite;"></div>
      <p style="font-size:13px;color:#B0A090;font-family:sans-serif;text-align:center;line-height:1.6;">Checking today's weather<br>and styling your look...</p>
    </div>
    <div id="outfit-content" style="display:none;padding:20px 16px 40px;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;" class="fade"></div>
    <div id="error-content" style="display:none;padding:40px 24px;text-align:center;">
      <p style="font-size:32px;margin:0 0 12px;">😕</p>
      <p id="error-msg" style="font-size:14px;color:#999;font-family:sans-serif;line-height:1.6;"></p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- WARDROBE VIEW -->
  <div id="view-wardrobe" style="display:none;">
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;padding:14px 16px 0;overflow-x:auto;">
      <button onclick="showCat('tops')" id="cat-tops" class="cat-btn active-cat">👚 Tops</button>
      <button onclick="showCat('bottoms')" id="cat-bottoms" class="cat-btn">👖 Bottoms</button>
      <button onclick="showCat('outerwear')" id="cat-outerwear" class="cat-btn">🧥 Outer</button>
      <button onclick="showCat('shoes')" id="cat-shoes" class="cat-btn">👞 Shoes</button>
      <button onclick="showCat('bags')" id="cat-bags" class="cat-btn">👜 Bags</button>
    </div>
    <div id="wardrobe-grid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;padding:16px;"></div>
  </div>

</div>

<style>
.cat-btn {
  padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 20px; border: none; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: #EDE8E0; color: #666; font-family: sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
}
.active-cat { background: #1A1A1A !important; color: #FAF8F4 !important; font-weight: 600 !important; }
</style>

<script>
const IMGS = {"t5_burgundy": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "o1_houndstooth": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "s1_loafers": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "g1_katespade": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "t1_pear": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "t2_cream": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "t3_champagne": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "t4_polkadot": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "t7_blush": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "t6_mustard": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "t8_plaid": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "s2_gazelles": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "s3_superstars": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "s4_uggs": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "s5_slippers": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "g2_longchamp": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "b1_bottom1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "b2_bottom2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "b3_bottom3": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};

const WARDROBE = {
  tops: [
    { id:"t1", name:"Brown Pear Knit", brand:"", temp:"cold", img:IMGS.t1_pear },
    { id:"t2", name:"Cream Satin Shirt", brand:"H&M", temp:"mild", img:IMGS.t2_cream },
    { id:"t3", name:"Champagne Satin Shirt", brand:"H&M", temp:"mild", img:IMGS.t3_champagne },
    { id:"t4", name:"Beige Polka Dot", brand:"Uniqlo", temp:"mild", img:IMGS.t4_polkadot },
    { id:"t5", name:"Burgundy Zip Knit", brand:"Candy Contemporary", temp:"cool", img:IMGS.t5_burgundy },
    { id:"t6", name:"Mustard Ruffle Blouse", brand:"Ann Taylor Petite", temp:"warm", img:IMGS.t6_mustard },
    { id:"t7", name:"Blush Floral Wrap Top", brand:"", temp:"mild", img:IMGS.t7_blush },
    { id:"t8", name:"Navy Plaid Flannel", brand:"", temp:"cool", img:IMGS.t8_plaid },
  ],
  outerwear: [
    { id:"o1", name:"Houndstooth Coat", brand:"Vero Moda", img:IMGS.o1_houndstooth },
  ],
  bottoms: [
    { id:"b1", name:"Bottom 1", brand:"", img:IMGS.b1_bottom1 },
    { id:"b2", name:"Bottom 2", brand:"", img:IMGS.b2_bottom2 },
    { id:"b3", name:"Bottom 3", brand:"", img:IMGS.b3_bottom3 },
  ],
  shoes: [
    { id:"s1", name:"Black Penny Loafers", brand:"Hush Puppies", rain:true, img:IMGS.s1_loafers },
    { id:"s2", name:"White Gazelles", brand:"Adidas", rain:false, img:IMGS.s2_gazelles },
    { id:"s3", name:"White Superstars", brand:"Adidas", rain:false, img:IMGS.s3_superstars },
    { id:"s4", name:"Black Mini UGGs", brand:"", rain:true, img:IMGS.s4_uggs },
  ],
  bags: [
    { id:"g1", name:"Kate Spade Tote", brand:"Kate Spade", img:IMGS.g1_katespade },
    { id:"g2", name:"Longchamp Le Pliage", brand:"Longchamp", img:IMGS.g2_longchamp },
  ],
};

function getItem(id) {
  return Object.values(WARDROBE).flat().find(i => i.id === id);
}

function getWeatherFeel(t) {
  if (t <= 10) return "It\'s absolutely freezing out there today.";
  if (t <= 14) return "It\'s very chilly out there today.";
  if (t <= 17) return "It\'s quite chilly out there today.";
  if (t <= 20) return "It\'s a cool one today.";
  if (t <= 24) return "It\'s pleasantly mild today.";
  if (t <= 28) return "It\'s warm and lovely today.";
  return "It\'s a hot one today!";
}

function getWeatherLabel(c) {
  if (c === 0) return "Clear sky";
  if (c <= 3) return "Partly cloudy";
  if (c <= 49) return "Foggy";
  if (c <= 67) return "Rainy";
  if (c <= 77) return "Snowy";
  if (c <= 82) return "Showers";
  return "Stormy";
}

function getWeatherIcon(c) {
  if (c === 0) return "☀️";
  if (c <= 3) return "⛅";
  if (c <= 49) return "🌫️";
  if (c <= 67) return "🌧️";
  if (c <= 82) return "🌦️";
  return "⛈️";
}

function getGreeting() {
  const h = new Date().getHours();
  if (h < 12) return "Good morning";
  if (h < 17) return "Good afternoon";
  return "Good evening";
}

function getDay() {
  return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-AU", { weekday:"long", day:"numeric", month:"long", year:"numeric" });
}

// Smart outfit selection — rotates for variety using day of week
function selectOutfit(temp, code, rain, wind) {
  const day = new Date().getDay();
  const needsCoat = temp <= 19 || rain > 35;
  const isRainy = rain > 40;

  // Pick top based on temperature
  let tops;
  if (temp <= 14) tops = ["t1","t5","t8"];
  else if (temp <= 19) tops = ["t5","t1","t7","t8","t3"];
  else if (temp <= 24) tops = ["t2","t3","t7","t4","t5"];
  else tops = ["t6","t7","t2","t3","t4"];

  // Pick shoes — rain-safe if wet
  let shoes;
  if (isRainy) shoes = ["s1","s4"];
  else if (temp <= 16) shoes = ["s1","s4","s2"];
  else shoes = ["s1","s2","s3"];

  // Bag — Longchamp if very rainy (nylon is water-resistant)
  const bag = rain > 60 ? "g2" : "g1";

  // Bottom — rotate through available
  const bottom = ["b1","b2","b3"][day % 3];
  const top = tops[day % tops.length];
  const shoe = shoes[day % shoes.length];
  const outerwear = needsCoat ? "o1" : null;

  // Build reason
  const topItem = getItem(top);
  const reasons = [];
  if (outerwear) reasons.push("The longline houndstooth coat elongates your petite 154cm frame beautifully while keeping you warm.");
  if (top === "t5") reasons.push("The fitted ribbed knit defines your waist and the cropped length pairs perfectly with a high-waisted bottom.");
  else if (top === "t1") reasons.push("The crew neck knit is cosy and the fitted silhouette keeps your proportions defined.");
  else if (top === "t6") reasons.push("The flutter sleeves add feminine detail at shoulder level, creating beautiful proportion for your frame.");
  else if (top === "t7") reasons.push("The wrap style creates a natural V-neckline that elongates your neckline and defines your waist.");
  else if (top === "t2" || top === "t3") reasons.push("The satin shirt tucked in creates a sleek, polished silhouette with clear waist definition.");
  else if (top === "t4") reasons.push("The camp collar adds personality while the fitted cut keeps proportions petite-friendly.");
  else if (top === "t8") reasons.push("The cropped flannel hits at exactly the right length to define your waist over a high-waisted bottom.");

  if (shoe === "s1") reasons.push("The black penny loafers ground the look with polish and the pointed toe elongates the leg line.");
  else if (shoe === "s4") reasons.push("The black mini UGGs keep you warm and cosy without breaking the dark leg-lengthening line.");
  else reasons.push("A monochromatic waist-down look in one colour elongates your legs beautifully.");

  return { top, bottom, outerwear, shoes: shoe, bag, reason: reasons.join(" ") };
}

let currentWeather = null;

async function loadOutfit() {
  document.getElementById("spinner").style.display = "flex";
  document.getElementById("outfit-content").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("error-content").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("refreshBtn").style.display = "none";

  let temp = 18, code = 2, wind = 15, rain = 20;

  try {
    const res = await fetch("https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=-33.8409&longitude=151.2068&current=temperature_2m,weather_code,wind_speed_10m,precipitation_probability&timezone=Australia%2FSydney", { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000) });
    if (res.ok) {
      const d = await res.json();
      temp = Math.round(d.current.temperature_2m);
      code = d.current.weather_code;
      wind = Math.round(d.current.wind_speed_10m);
      rain = d.current.precipitation_probability || 0;
    }
  } catch(e) { console.warn("Weather fallback to defaults"); }

  currentWeather = { temp, code, wind, rain };

  // Update header
  document.getElementById("dateLabel").textContent = getDay();
  document.getElementById("greeting").textContent = getGreeting() + ", Sharlene! 👋";
  document.getElementById("weatherFeel").textContent = getWeatherFeel(temp) + " Here\'s what you\'ll wear. ✨";
  document.getElementById("weatherIcon").textContent = getWeatherIcon(code);
  document.getElementById("weatherTemp").textContent = temp + "°C";
  document.getElementById("weatherDetail").textContent = getWeatherLabel(code) + " · " + rain + "% rain · " + wind + " km/h wind";

  // Select outfit
  const outfit = selectOutfit(temp, code, rain, wind);
  renderOutfit(outfit);
}

function renderOutfit(outfit) {
  const container = document.getElementById("outfit-content");
  const pieces = [];
  if (outfit.outerwear) pieces.push({ id: outfit.outerwear, label: "OUTERWEAR" });
  pieces.push({ id: outfit.top, label: "TOP" });
  pieces.push({ id: outfit.bottom, label: "BOTTOM" });
  pieces.push({ id: outfit.shoes, label: "SHOES" });
  pieces.push({ id: outfit.bag, label: "BAG" });

  let html = `<div style="margin-bottom:8px;">
    <h2 style="margin:0 0 2px;font-size:22px;font-weight:400;color:#1A1A1A;">Today\'s Look</h2>
    <p style="margin:0;font-size:11px;color:#B0A090;font-family:sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;">Styled for ${currentWeather.temp}°C · North Sydney Office</p>
  </div>`;

  for (const piece of pieces) {
    const item = getItem(piece.id);
    if (!item) continue;
    html += `<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);margin-bottom:10px;">
      <img src="${item.img}" alt="${item.name}" style="width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;background:#EDE8E0;">
      <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
        <p style="margin:0 0 3px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#B0A090;font-family:sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;">${piece.label}</p>
        <p style="margin:0 0 2px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1A1A1A;font-family:Georgia,serif;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${item.name}</p>
        <p style="margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#AAA;font-family:sans-serif;">${item.brand || ""}</p>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }

  html += `<div style="background:#1A1A1A;border-radius:16px;padding:20px;margin-top:4px;">
    <p style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#C8A882;font-family:sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;">Why This Works For You</p>
    <p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;color:#E8E0D4;font-family:sans-serif;line-height:1.75;">${outfit.reason}</p>
  </div>`;

  container.innerHTML = html;
  document.getElementById("spinner").style.display = "none";
  container.style.display = "flex";
  container.style.flexDirection = "column";
  document.getElementById("refreshBtn").style.display = "block";
}

// WARDROBE VIEW
let currentCat = "tops";

function showCat(cat) {
  currentCat = cat;
  document.querySelectorAll(".cat-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active-cat"));
  document.getElementById("cat-" + cat).classList.add("active-cat");

  const items = WARDROBE[cat] || [];
  const grid = document.getElementById("wardrobe-grid");
  grid.innerHTML = items.map(item => `
    <div style="background:#fff;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);${item.homeOnly ? "opacity:0.5;" : ""}">
      <div style="height:150px;background:#EDE8E0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;">
        <img src="${item.img}" alt="${item.name}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">
        ${item.homeOnly ? `<div style="position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 7px;font-size:9px;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;">HOME</div>` : ""}
      </div>
      <div style="padding:10px 12px 12px;">
        <p style="margin:0 0 2px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#1A1A1A;line-height:1.3;">${item.name}</p>
        ${item.brand ? `<p style="margin:0;font-size:10px;color:#C8A882;font-family:sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;">${item.brand}</p>` : ""}
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join("");
}

// TABS
function showTab(tab) {
  document.getElementById("view-outfit").style.display = tab === "outfit" ? "block" : "none";
  document.getElementById("view-wardrobe").style.display = tab === "wardrobe" ? "block" : "none";
  document.getElementById("tab-outfit").style.fontWeight = tab === "outfit" ? "700" : "400";
  document.getElementById("tab-outfit").style.color = tab === "outfit" ? "#1A1A1A" : "#BBB";
  document.getElementById("tab-outfit").style.borderBottom = tab === "outfit" ? "2px solid #1A1A1A" : "2px solid transparent";
  document.getElementById("tab-wardrobe").style.fontWeight = tab === "wardrobe" ? "700" : "400";
  document.getElementById("tab-wardrobe").style.color = tab === "wardrobe" ? "#1A1A1A" : "#BBB";
  document.getElementById("tab-wardrobe").style.borderBottom = tab === "wardrobe" ? "2px solid #1A1A1A" : "2px solid transparent";
  if (tab === "wardrobe") showCat(currentCat);
}

// INIT
document.getElementById("dateLabel").textContent = getDay();
document.getElementById("greeting").textContent = getGreeting() + ", Sharlene! 👋";
loadOutfit();
</script>
</body>
</html>
